title: Claude + Codex Setup
summary: The full setup Jesse runs on his always-on Mac: Claude Code and Codex share the same skills, memory and standing instructions; a guardian checks every scheduled job each 10 minutes and repairs it or alerts you once; alerts come by Telegram (urgent now, the rest in one evening summary); phone access through the Claude app; nightly private GitHub backup, safe auto-updates and a login-expiry watchdog. Context files are blank: your Claude interviews you to fill them in.
how_to_use: Unzip, open the folder in Claude Code and say: follow ONBOARD.md. Or by hand: run ./install.sh (never overwrites your files, also downloads the companion skills from this shelf), then double-click ~/JesseOS/workspace/setup/finish-setup.command for the sign-ins and to start the background jobs.
requires: macOS, Claude Code on your own Claude plan, git, GitHub CLI, python3. Telegram for alerts. Codex is optional.
